description: Dataset for A semi-analytical beam model for the vibration of railway tracks is a data set deposited in University of Southampton Repository by its authors Dimitrios Kostovasilis, David Thompson. Dataset containing all data from figures in the paper Kostovasilis, Dimitrios, Thompson, David and Hussein, Mohammed (2016) A semi-analytical beam model for the vibration of railway tracks. Journal of Sound and Vibration (http://doi.org/10.1016/j.jsv.2016.12.033). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
